units: metre; world axes x east, y north, z up; origin at south-west corner of the gate hall
dimensions_note: dimensions guide identity and plan layout, not engineering metrology

gate_hall.e_gate: waist-high stainless cabinet pair with two glass flaps; boarding-pass reader on the cabinet top; walking direction south -> north

partition.material: painted wall, lower half; frosted glass, upper half

conveyor.flow: entry (west) -> x-ray tunnel -> exit roller bed (east)

screening_lane.monitor: single flat monitor on the operator station, facing the operator (south side)
screening_lane.belt_stop_button: red mushroom push button on the operator station, right of the monitor
screening_lane.trays: grey plastic screening trays, about 0.60 x 0.40 x 0.12

characters.passenger: adult traveller in a grey wool coat; carries a red duffel bag (about 0.50 x 0.28 x 0.28, two carry handles) and a paper boarding pass
characters.screener: adult security screener, navy uniform, handheld radio on the station
characters.officer: adult security officer, navy uniform, shoulder radio microphone; posted beyond gate 2

props.bag: the passenger's red duffel, travels on the belt inside a grey tray
props.second_tray: another passenger's tray with a dark backpack, following the red bag on the belt

dialogue.screener: Lane two, hold the passenger in the grey coat.

identity_constraints: same passenger (grey coat) in S1, S2, S4 and S6
same red bag and tray in S1, S3, S5 and S6
same screener in S3, S5 and S6; same officer in S4 and S6
the two spaces keep the plan geometry of layout.svg

continuity.lane_screen_direction: in lane shots seen from the operator side, the belt runs screen-left to screen-right
